posts.title: RSS, Without the Noise
posts.description: I’ve always liked RSS. You choose what to follow. New posts appear in order. There’s no algorithm deciding what should make you angry or keep you scrolling. It represents a version of the web I care about. I’ve tried many RSS readers over the years and never quite found the perfect one for me. So I decided to build it. posts.title: Less Duct Tape, More Website
posts.description: I think more people should own their own little corner of the internet. I don’t mean everyone needs to suddenly become a blogger, but it’s nice to have somewhere you can write things down. Post photos. Link to projects. Not a feed you’re renting from someone else.
